stemMarkdown: Two cars start at the same time from two points 93 km apart and travel towards each other at 28 km/h and 49 km/h respectively. After how many hours will they meet? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Relative speed (approaching) $= 28 + 49 = 77$ km/h. Time to meet $= \dfrac{\text{distance}}{\text{relative speed}} = \dfrac{93}{77} = 1.21$ hours.
